user_query: My family is planning a weekend getaway and we want to visit a brewery that offers a variety of beers for both adults and kids. Can you suggest a family-friendly brewery and provide the nutritional analysis for the food options they have? Additionally, we would like to try some unique cocktails during our visit.

TaskList.description: Search for family-friendly breweries that offer a variety of beers suitable for both adults and kids.
Retrieve the menu options from the selected brewery including food and cocktail offerings.
Provide nutritional analysis for the food options available at the selected brewery.
List unique cocktail options available at the brewery.
